# Color

136 primitives, 58 used.

Each colour is a whole scale in each theme. The lanes show what its tokens paint: backgrounds, edges and rings, and text. A filled step is in use; an empty slot waits for one. Under each scale, one row per token: its colour, its name, the step it points at and the value. Point at a row to find its step. A row links to the token's guidance in [Foundations](../foundations/color).

## Stone

22 tokens in light, 17 tokens in dark.
